tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Block launches Dessa, an artificial intelligence voice model trained entirely on human conversation, offering natural and emotional voice interactions. Reported by The Economic Times: Confirmed.
OpenAI's model decoded a 217-year-old Napoleonic cipher from a blurry image in what many didn't believe at first. Reported by Yahoo Tech.
Nor-Tech launches the AI ProServer with NVIDIA H200 and L40S GPUs designed for artificial intelligence workloads. Reported by PRLog.
Hong Kong's banking regulator releases the ART framework setting accountability, resilience, and trust rules for bank artificial intelligence. Reported by Compliance Week.
Reported by Fello AI: GLM-5.3 beats older GLM-5.2 and rivals on benchmarks at 2.9x cheaper input and 4.5x cheaper output.
Free every hour.
